title: Pair Sum at Scale
prerequisite: Lesson 2 and basic TypeScript Map usage.
hints: For the current value x, the only useful earlier value is target - x. Ask whether that complement has already appeared.
Store each previously seen value as a Map key and its index as the value, giving average O(1) complement lookup.
At each index, check the Map for target - nums[i] before storing nums[i], which also prevents reusing the same index.
